environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed in an account governed by an AWS Organizations SCP that enforces tag-based conditional access on secretsmanager:GetSecretValue with aws:ResourceTag/rotation-schedule=60s. The secret prod/database/credentials has automatic rotation configured via a Secrets Manager rotation Lambda with a RotationSchedule of 60 seconds (using createSecret/setSecret/testSecret/finishSecret steps). The secret's VersionStage AWSCURRENT is atomically swapped every 60s, and the previous version is immediately marked AWSPREVIOUS with the underlying database credential (IAM DB auth token) invalidated via an RDS API call in the finishSecret step. Additionally, the Lambda execution environment uses AWS Lambda SnapStart with Firecracker microVM isolation where each invocation gets a fresh restored snapshot (no warm container reuse), meaning heap state from a previous invocation including any corrupted freed chunks is never carried forward to subsequent invocations.
